scripts.dev: lsof -ti tcp:8081 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run sim:pin && APP_VARIANT=development expo start --dev-client --ios
scripts.dev:native: lsof -ti tcp:8081 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run sim:pin && APP_VARIANT=development expo run:ios
scripts.sim:pin: UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep 'iPhone Air (' | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}') && xcrun simctl boot "$UDID" 2>/dev/null; defaults write com.apple.iphonesimulator CurrentDeviceUDID "$UDID"; open "$(xcode-select -p)/../Applications/DeviceHub.app" 2>/dev/null || open -a Simulator
scripts.lint: bun run codegen && oxlint src/ index.ts app.config.ts -c ../../oxlint.config.ts --tsconfig tsconfig.json --disable-nested-config
scripts.lint:fix: bun run codegen && oxlint src/ index.ts app.config.ts -c ../../oxlint.config.ts --tsconfig tsconfig.json --disable-nested-config --fix
